name: InvoiceOps Live Sheet Posting Pilot v1
description: Builds live-posting pending actions from a completed InvoiceOps frame. Does NOT execute live writes. Stops at WAITING_FOR_EXECUTE.

side_effect_policy.note: This manifest only builds posting plans and pending actions. No live write is executed here. Live execution requires operator approval and separate CLI command.

steps.command: [t:invoiceops/build_live_posting_plan -> posting_plan] frame_id=$inputs.frame_id invoice_id=$inputs.invoice_id invoice_number=$inputs.invoice_number supplier_name=$inputs.supplier_name po_number=$inputs.po_number match_status=$inputs.match_status prepared_writes=$inputs.prepared_writes

notes: This manifest does not execute any live write.
It builds a posting_plan with pending_actions in PENDING_APPROVAL state.
The operator must review the approval_pack, approve each pending_action, then run: taskframe invoiceops live-posting execute --frame-id <id> --action-id <id> --confirm '<phrase>'
Only sheet/write_rows is executable via the live side-effect model (Spec 155).
Gmail, Calendar, RPA, and all mutation tools remain blocked.
Allowed targets: invoice_register, match_register, exception_register, ledger_register.
Blocked targets: supplier_master, po_register, goods_receipt_register, bank_register, payment_register.
